section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedures for the present study, which is part of a larger Portuguese project. The sample was recruited through online advertisements and initially consisted of 514 participants (494 women, 20 men) aged 17-57. Data was subsequently cleaned by excluding all male participants and female participants outside the 18-54 age range.
